# gatev1

```go
import gatev1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/gate/v1"
```

Package gatev1 is the gate/v1 contract: what admits requests on a multisite host, before an instance is served or forwarded (a firewall: peer allow lists, client IPs, rate limits). Gates run in order, every one must admit.

A host-scope service contract: providers register on the host's scope (ProvideIn), not on an app.

Source: [`ext/contracts/gate/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/gate/v1).

## Variables

<a id="contract"></a>

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewContract[Gate]("gate/v1", extkit.Many)
```

Contract is gate/v1, on a host's scope.

## Types

### ClientIPResolver

```go
type ClientIPResolver interface {
	ClientIP(r *http.Request) netip.Addr
}
```

ClientIPResolver is an optional [Gate](#gate) extension: the request's real client (e.g. from CF-Connecting-IP when the peer is a trusted proxy). When a gate implements it, a request served here reaches the app with RemoteAddr set to that client, so PocketBase's logs, e.RealIP() and its own rate limits see the visitor instead of the proxy.

### Gate

```go
type Gate interface {
	AllowPeer(r *http.Request) bool
	Admit(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, inst sourcev1.Instance) (release func(), ok bool)
}
```

Gate admits requests. AllowPeer runs before routing and refuses with 403; Admit runs before an instance's request is served here or forwarded to another server, may answer it itself (ok=false), and otherwise returns a release function called when the response ends (long-lived responses hold it until they end).
